conclusions.actual_editor_launch_boundary: Not verified: dispatch_live remains unimplemented and this diagnostic CLI did not run under the Phase 7 filesystem profile.
conclusions.no_model_substitution: Experimental allowProviderModelFallback field exists in schema; not behaviorally verified against the live provider.
conclusions.provider_billing_cap: No demonstrated provider-side billed-usage ceiling. Tested max_cost/max_billed_units config overrides are rejected.
conclusions.provider_max_output_tokens: Unsupported by the tested CLI flag/config controls; baseline and accepted budget features serialize no max_output_tokens/max_tokens field.
conclusions.rollout_budget_feature: Recognized and adds rollout_budget input text; no provider hard output limit serialized.
conclusions.token_budget_feature: Recognized and present in model-visible input; no provider hard output limit serialized.
conclusions.tool_allowlist: Not verified. Some feature switches alter input markers, but absence of top-level tools does not mean no tools; code-mode descriptions are in input. No complete tool registry or actual denied tool execution established.
conclusions.zero_retry_ambiguous_drop: Verified for the local capture case with explicit zero request/stream retries plus unbounded_connection_retries=false: one request and terminal exit1.

direct_flag_check.result: unexpected argument --max-output-tokens; parser rejects before dispatch

cli_behavior_evidence.evidence_scope: Actual installed binary, strict configuration parser, and loopback-only synthetic provider request capture. No real provider response or model generation.
interpretation_limits: A fake server receiving a requested model string is not real-provider acceptance or model identity verification.
An HTTP400 response deliberately stops before inference; its exit1 is expected.
Request body digests describe temporary diagnostic payloads; raw prompts/tool dumps/private paths are not published.
A configuration field being accepted is not evidence of provider-side enforcement.
These diagnostic requests are not experimental editor interactions and consume no frontier-model generation budget.

network_boundary.scope: Network-only restriction for the diagnostic CLI; NOT the Phase 7 editor filesystem isolation profile.

reproduction_harness.validation_scope: Public sanitized harness compiled and ran baseline plus ambiguous-drop cases; ten historical control cases retained above.

conditions.condition: No supported live provider adapter is registered.
conditions.expected_evidence: Executable adapter selecting the requested model, binding the narrow contract, controls and returned provenance.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Implement one adapter only after the selected interface demonstrates the mandatory controls.

conditions.available_evidence: Host Python fixture denials passed; CLI executable/provider network are not permitted by this profile.
conditions.condition: The tested stdlib Python profile has never launched a live editor or its complete tool surface.
conditions.expected_evidence: Denial tests on the exact editor launch: final tasks/answers/results, host files, descriptors, plugins and network routes.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Build a narrow provider broker and verify the exact launch/tools; do not widen the Python profile or infer equivalence.

conditions.available_evidence: max_output_tokens is an offline envelope/reservation; local deadlines and output usage events are not remote generation caps.
conditions.condition: No demonstrated frontier-provider enforcement of the 64-token total output bound, including reasoning.
conditions.expected_evidence: Supported dispatch control observed on the actual provider request and documented/enforced at the provider.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Use an explicitly supported provider-enforced output limit for this exact selector, or propose a protocol change; do not treat CLI goals as a cap.

conditions.condition: No provider-side billed-usage cap is demonstrated; the selected offline budget has no monetary ceiling configured.
conditions.expected_evidence: If a billed ceiling is configured: establish its unit and enforceable conservative bound before dispatch. Otherwise record available usage without claiming a monetary cap.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Do not invent a mandatory money cap from billed_units:null. Any future configured cap requires demonstrated enforcement.

conditions.available_evidence: gpt-6-astra is exposed; allowProviderModelFallback exists in experimental schema. No real dispatch acceptance or response was observed.
conditions.condition: A catalog selector and schema fallback flag do not demonstrate no substitution on a real dispatch.
conditions.expected_evidence: Explicit requested selector, no fallback behavior, and execution-interface model/reroute metadata.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Wire and test no-fallback behavior before launch; reject reroute/mismatch using interface events.

conditions.condition: No existing authorized live session can reserve this one request.
conditions.expected_evidence: A non-cancelled authorized live ledger with one request/sequence, 64 frontier tokens and 30 seconds available, with complete billing semantics.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Preserve spent offline budgets; explicitly authorize/freeze a live budget only after capability gates pass. Never reset a run.

conditions.available_evidence: Read-only diagnostic access works; ordinary controller resume correctly refuses changed implementation.
conditions.condition: The selected historical session is bound to the original package hashes, which differ from this readiness implementation.
conditions.expected_evidence: Exact original package/runtime hashes for any resume, or an explicitly authorized new protocol with budget provenance.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Keep the historical session immutable. Do not relax the source freeze or recreate its ledger to obtain live budget.

conditions.available_evidence: Separate inert zero-action plan and exact acknowledgement validator are implemented; no transport exists.
conditions.condition: Connection diagnostic must expose no proposal/probe/action execution.
conditions.expected_evidence: One structured acknowledgement request, empty tools, exact response validator, no calls to _execute_action.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Bind this narrow contract in the future verified adapter; do not reuse the six-tool offline action contract.

conditions.available_evidence: Local worker cancellation is tested. It cannot prove a remote provider stops generation when a local client is killed.
conditions.condition: No live transport demonstrates zero automatic retries and remote cancellation/outcome semantics.
conditions.expected_evidence: One provider request, bounded local supervisor, no retry after an ambiguous remote outcome; explicit remote cancellation capability or limitation.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Verify transport retry/cancel behavior and charge ambiguous outcome conservatively; retain provider hard cap independently.

conditions.condition: The requested selector has not been accepted by an actual live execution interface.
conditions.expected_evidence: Interface-produced session/dispatch acceptance for gpt-6-astra, separate from configured request and model text.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Record live session/dispatch metadata during the gated one-request check.

conditions.condition: No actual session/response model metadata has been observed.
conditions.expected_evidence: Interface response model/provider/reroute metadata, never the model's self-description.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Capture authenticated interface events; reject mismatches and retain unknown fields as null.

conditions.available_evidence: CLI schema exposes token usage events. Actual provider usage and billing are null, not fixture zero.
conditions.condition: No frontier usage has been observed because no frontier request was sent.
conditions.expected_evidence: Record interface token usage and billed usage when exposed; preserve unknowns and charge ambiguous outcomes conservatively.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Capture metering during the gated connection check; do not describe it as an execution cap.
